cycles.method: verify_bounds.py: 737 conservative source-word/call units per sample including split setup; the bound is set by the cold start-up path of the left ring (the first 8,192 samples after init), where the shadow write and three helper reads are all charged. benchmark.py: 362.375 observed net executed instructions/sample on both cores, cold/warm history, fixed/moving controls and all splits 0..15 (0.1.2 under the same run: 394.625). Initialization is separate; chip timing is unmeasured.

stock.justification: Preserves all original sine values and the full stereo sweep while protecting live stock shared words. 1.154 times matched Spring, 1.237 times stock Chorus; 8.2% below 0.1.2 (394.625) with bit-identical output, 12.6% below it at fixed settings without a trig split (339.375 against 388.4375). The conservative static bound is 5 units above 0.1.2's 732 because the model charges the start-up path. The modeled four-instance split block with initialization is 47576 units. No physical timing or headroom is established.

scope: 31-second native DSP-only replay of three tempo-derived LFO target streams per instance (120 BPM; 1/2/4-beat periods), rapid endpoint locks and 12 parameter-byte targets each step. Only SPD/RNG/MIX have an audible path; other slots are inactive. Both cores, four independent rings each, 0.98-FS bursts plus tones, dirty state and local/shared canaries. ColdFire sequencer/LFO, scenes, MIDI, transport, project and physical timing are not tested.
